title: test(core): widen the record-title step-numbering pin to its sibling test file
body:
Fixes #6843

## What changed

- `packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/record-title.test.ts:133` — the comment on the record-level name probe said "step 3b"; it now says "step 4b". That is the number `record-title.ts` gives the rung everywhere it states its ADR-0079 ladder (step 3 is `objectDef.titleFormat`, a rendered template; step 4 is the `objectDef.fields` derivation with `NAME_ISH_RECORD_KEYS` beneath it as 4b), and the number the same file already used at three other sites (`:150`, `:245`, `:252`).
- `packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/record-title.stepNumbering.test.ts` — the pin from PR #6842 scanned `record-title.ts` only, so this drift sat in its declared blind spot. Its scanned set is now an explicit list, `SCAN_SET`, naming `record-title.ts` and `__tests__/record-title.test.ts`, and:
  - a vacuity guard requires the set to be non-empty, to contain both files by name, both present on disk and non-empty, and to exclude this pin itself (its docblock spells `3b` as the bug it describes);
  - every scanned file declares a label floor in `CONTROL_LABEL_COUNTS`, typed over the set so a new entry without a floor is a compile error; the cross-set floor must be greater than 0;
  - the collector also reads the hyphenated `step-4b` spelling the sibling uses, and reports file plus line for every stray label;
  - a fixture self-test proves the collector and the verdict helper (`strayLabels`) depend on their input — the fixture carries the original uncorrected `:133` text — and that `it('0b. …')` test names stay out of the population;
  - one absolute pin keeps `titleFormat` on step 3 and the fields derivation on step 4 — the numbers the hand-citing sites outside the module carry (`InterfaceListPage` prose, the #6530 changeset, this sibling test). Everything else stays relative to the ladder, so a deliberate renumbering edits two constants on purpose instead of silently reconciling a stray label by moving the ladder.
- `.changeset/6843-record-title-step-numbering-scan.md` — empty frontmatter; comment text and tests only, nothing is released.

## Measured before widening

Of the 49 files under `packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/`, exactly one besides the pin cites the ladder: `record-title.test.ts` (`step 3b` once, `step 4b` twice, `step-4b` once). No other file enters the population, so this is not a bigger card. Repo-wide `git grep 'step 3b'` over `packages/*/src/*` and `apps/*` now hits only the pin's own fixture and expectation lines (the lit control for the sweep); `step 4b` / `step-4b` hits 10 lines.

## Evidence (all at `e64f3af96`, vitest root-relative form, runs under the shared verify lock)

Red on the uncorrected file, before the one-line edit: the widened pin failed with `sub-step labels disagreeing with the ladder's 4b` listing `__tests__/record-title.test.ts:133 "step 3b" says 3` — 1 failed, 6 passed. After the edit: 7 passed.

Ablation legs — each mutation proven on disk by `grep -c` before the run, each restored with `git checkout HEAD -- ABSOLUTE_PATH` under a trap and proven by `git hash-object` equal to the `HEAD` blob plus an empty `git diff HEAD`:

- V1 empty `SCAN_SET` — RED: guard `expected 0 to be greater than or equal to 2`; cross-set floor `expected 0 to be greater than 0` (2 failed, 5 passed — the per-file loop is vacuous over an empty set, which is exactly why the guard exists).
- V2 mis-pathed entry (`record-titel`) — RED: guard `to include '__tests__/record-title.test.ts'`, plus ENOENT in the two reading tests (3 failed).
- S re-introduce `3b` at `:133` — RED naming `:133` (1 failed).
- R1 the plausible wrong "fix": renumber the derivation 4 to 3 consistently in module and sibling — every relative check stays green; only the absolute pin fails: `fields-derivation sites not on step 4` listing 3 sites (1 failed).
- R2 renumber `titleFormat` 3 to 2 in the module — only the absolute pin fails: `titleFormat sites not on step 3` listing 4 sites (1 failed).
- C1 extractor returns constant 4 — only the fixture self-test fails (`[[2,4],[3,4],[4,4],…]` vs `[[2,3],[3,3],[4,3],…]`).
- C2 verdict constant (`strayLabels` returns `[]`) — only the fixture self-test fails.
- C3 scan collects nothing — per-file control (`record-title.ts: 0 sub-step label(s) found, control floor is 3`), cross-set floor and self-test fail (3 failed).

No void legs. No `dist/` is involved: the pin reads source through `node:fs`, so no build step sits between a mutation and its measurement.

Leg D, JSON reporter over `pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/`: 132 files, 701 suites, 2792 tests, all passed; `record-title.stepNumbering.test.ts` 7/7 passed, `record-title.test.ts` 75/75 passed; no death strings.

`pnpm --filter @object-ui/core type-check` (script name echoed; `@object-ui/types` built first): 0 TS errors, and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` reads all three `record-title*` files. ESLint on both test files: 0 errors (2 pre-existing `no-explicit-any` warnings at `record-title.test.ts:311` and `:362`, lines not touched here).

`node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: "2 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s) … Every one of them has an EMPTY frontmatter — declared as releasing nothing, which is the explicit exemption and a complete answer to this gate."

`node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test PATHS`: "NOT GOVERNED — 3 path(s) checked against 5 governed surface(s); none matched."
